prompt: I want a GRPO training env for word-unscramble. The model gets a scrambled word (like 'ranbcah' for 'branch') and has to submit the unscrambled version. There should be a hint tool that reveals one correct letter position. Cap at 6 attempts. Please add it to openenv-custom-training/ and wire it into train.py's dispatch. Use one of the SakThai tools models as the default base.

assertions.text: Scaffolded env file exists under outputs/openenv-custom-training/env_*.py or similar
Picked Tier A (no server) — task never executes model strings
Env class has __init__(self) with no non-self parameters
Env class initializes self.reward = 0.0 and self.done = False
Every public tool method has a Google-style docstring with an Args: block
MAX_ATTEMPTS (or equivalent cap) is set to 6 as requested
Module-level exports present: ENVIRONMENT_FACTORY, REWARD_FUNCS, TRAIN_DATASET, DEFAULT_MODEL
DEFAULT_MODEL is a *-tools base (NOT a *-merged trap that would break tool-calling)
build_dataset produces conversational `prompt` (list of {role,content} dicts) plus a scoring-only column
Dataset is built deterministically (no random.randint calls)
notes.md explains tier choice and how to wire into train.py
validate_env.py runs cleanly (0 errors) on the generated file
